poses: Preparation: feet planted, both hands close on hammer handle at waist, hammer head drawn back low toward viewer RIGHT. Face looks toward viewer LEFT.
Wind-up: turn torso slightly toward viewer RIGHT, both hands bring hammer back beside right hip, bend knees subtly. Hammer head low, face still LEFT.
Impact at0.30s: decisive upward-forward swing toward viewer LEFT. Both hands on handle, hammer head extended to left at chest height, torso leans left slightly, rear heel lifted.
Follow-through: hammer continues upward over left shoulder, elbows bent, torso straightening. Keep hammer fully visible above LEFT side of head.
Recovery: hammer head near left shoulder now being lowered, elbows relax, feet settle, cape follows motion gently.
Return: lower hammer beside viewer LEFT thigh toward original idle resting position; gentle expression restored, compact upright posture.
Preparation for heavy overhead hammer strike: slightly lower hips, both hands grip hammer handle before chest, hammer head beside right shoulder.
Lift: both arms raise hammer above crown, elbows bent; hammer head above and slightly to viewer RIGHT, cape begins to lift.
Peak anticipation: hammer held above and behind head, knees bent gently, weight on rear foot, gaze LEFT. No giant halo.
Impact at0.50s: bring hammer forcefully down toward viewer LEFT, hammer head near ground in front of left foot, body crouched but head same size, both hands grip handle.
Follow-through hold: head and shoulders slightly lowered, hammer head still near LEFT ground, cape settling, body stable.
Recovery: lift hammer back to lowered resting position on viewer LEFT, rise almost upright, knees straightening naturally.
Ready after magic charge: rotate spear to horizontal at waist with blade toward viewer LEFT, two hands spaced on shaft, compact slight knee bend.
Draw back: pull spear grip toward right hip, blade still LEFT at waist height, torso coiled slightly right, rear elbow back.
Thrust one: extend both arms toward viewer LEFT, long spear perfectly horizontal at waist/chest height, a small forward lunge, both feet visible.
Retract one: bring spear back half-way toward waist, front elbow bending, leftward spear remains level, knees still gently bent.
Thrust two: second sharp leftward thrust, leading shoulder advances slightly, shaft horizontal, front knee bends a little more, rear leg SHORT.
Retract two: spear drawn back toward right waist, elbows bent, cape trails right, calm intense expression unchanged.
Thrust three maximum reach: push spear toward viewer LEFT with fully extended compact arms and small torso lean; spear complete within canvas, no foreshortened giant blade.
Recovery: spear pulled back then begins returning to original diagonal guard, hips rise, feet planted, no magic orb.
Charge start: bend knees slightly, grip spear at chest with blade diagonally up toward viewer LEFT, chin lowered, serious brows.
Gather power: bring shaft closer to torso, shoulders lifted, spear tip higher toward upper LEFT, short legs remain planted.
Peak charge: straighten torso, draw spear back beside right shoulder with blade pointing upward, elbows tightly bent, mouth opens slightly in forceful shout.
Release at0.60s: thrust spear upward high diagonally to LEFT, chest opens, head tips upward subtly, strong shout, feet remain on ground. No dragon or aura painted in.
Hold release: spear stays high, arms soften a little, cape lifted outward, mouth closes into focused expression.
Recovery: lower spear into original diagonal guard, shoulders drop, knees straighten, original serious face.
Prepare volley: knees slightly flexed, throwing forearm with original red/silver shuriken draws back to right shoulder, free hand guards low waist, look LEFT.

Throw one release: throwing arm snaps toward viewer LEFT at chest height, open fingerless-gloved hand, shuriken has LEFT THE HAND and is not painted in flight. Free hand holds remaining original shuriken low.
Quick reload: throwing elbow bent halfway back, wrist close to upper chest, ready small red/silver shuriken gripped between fingers, compact torso.
Throw two release: leading arm extends LEFT, wrist flick down, hand open with no projectile attached; free hand low, head size fixed.
Quick reload for next release: pull forearm inward toward chin, elbow points right, original red/silver shuriken visible in hand, knees gently flexed.
Throw three/four repeat release: arm sweeps LEFT on slightly higher angle, fingers open, no flying shuriken in PNG, headband tails and jacket flutter to right.
Follow-through: throwing forearm extends low LEFT after final release, torso pitched very slightly forward, free hand returns to guard.
Recovery: elbow comes back down, both hands resume original low shuriken guard, straighten posture, original focused expression.
Wind-up: compact knees gently bent, original curved dagger drawn back across chest toward right shoulder, free hand guarding waist, face LEFT.
Fast slash one: extend dagger diagonally downward toward viewer LEFT in front of hips, torso turns left slightly, blade silhouette clear, no painted slash trails.
Reverse slash: dagger moves up-left to shoulder height, leading elbow bent, shoulders twist back, head still LEFT.
Cross-body slash: dagger sweeps horizontally left across lower chest, free hand lifted behind for balance, knees bent, silver bob stable.
Low slash: original single dagger extends low LEFT near knee level, torso crouches slightly without long legs, scarf trails right.
Rising slash: dagger lifts high LEFT beside head, compact elbow then extends, knees begin to rise, no dagger duplication.
Finishing slash hold: dagger ends horizontal LEFT near waist, leading shoulder forward, eyes intensely focused, original black mask.
Recover to guard: single dagger returns across chest as original, free hand lowers, feet stable, scarf settles.
Prepare detonation: upright near idle, original dagger lowered safely beside right thigh, free gloved hand raised before chest with fingers curled.
Gather: free hand lifts near chin, thumb and middle finger touching ready to snap, eyes LEFT, dagger still lowered.
Trigger at0.30s: snap fingers of free hand extending toward viewer LEFT, arm half-extended, torso steady. No coins, explosion or purple vortex painted in.
Follow-through: free palm opens toward LEFT after snap, shoulders relax, short legs planted, dagger still in other hand.
Recovery: free arm lowers, dagger returns to familiar diagonal chest guard, original face and stance.
Prepare special strike: compact low stance, original curved dagger held back at right hip, free hand extends slightly LEFT, shoulders coiled.
Wind-up rotation: torso turns slightly right, dagger arm lifts behind shoulder, free forearm crosses chest, feet pivot in place.
Tornado launch at0.30s: sweep original dagger in broad horizontal arc toward viewer LEFT, free palm pushes left, torso follows. Keep one real dagger; magical blades are separate effects.
Second cross slash: dagger arm crosses down-left in front of body, free arm draws back right, both knees bent, scarf thrown outward.
Release: open chest slightly, dagger at low LEFT completing slash, free hand raised to shoulder, look LEFT, no magical letters or tornado painted in.
Sustained casting hold: balanced low guard, dagger forward-left at waist, free palm extended left, intense eyes; keep same short limbs. This pose holds while separately rendered attacks continue.
Recovery start: withdraw free palm and dagger toward torso, knees straighten, scarf settles.
Return: upright original dagger guard across chest, relaxed shoulders, original focused expression.
Preparation: original front three-quarter LEFT-facing identity, lift red-jewel cane off floor, left arm lightly out, right hand fans three wine-red gold cards near chest. Feet close and steady.

Rotation0deg LOOP START: front three-quarter view looking LEFT, begin elegant upright turn on balls of feet, cane angled horizontally across waist, free gloved palm poised with one wine-red gold card. Coat tails flare slightly.

Rotation45deg: LEFT-facing profile, visible near violet eye, nose points LEFT, both shoulders turning; cane angled diagonally before waist, short legs pivot in place, hat and blue feathers retain exact design.
Rotation90deg: rear-left three-quarter view, mostly back of blond hair and hat visible, only sliver of cheek, white cape with gold edge opens right, cane in same anatomical hand follows turn.
Rotation135deg: nearly BACK view, face mostly hidden, crown/back of hat and blue feather attachment coherent, cape shows white/gold exterior and royal blue lining; cane held at waist follows body.

Rotation180deg: full BACK view, NO face or front eyes visible, blond nape under white/blue/gold hat, white cape with gold scroll borders, short trouser legs and small boots pivot. Cane partly visible beside waist.
Rotation225deg: rear-RIGHT three-quarter view, back mostly visible, far profile begins to appear on RIGHT, cape flares opposite side, same hat/cane outfit not mirrored accessory positions.
Rotation270deg: RIGHT-facing profile, one violet eye visible looking RIGHT as he turns through, shoulders side-on, cane crosses waist, small feet pivot, blue feathers at correct hat attachment.

Rotation315deg LOOP END: front-right three-quarter view turning back toward original left-facing front pose, both violet eyes emerging, cane angled across waist, hand poised for cards, cape returning to initial flare.

Finish: original front three-quarter LEFT view, stop turn gently, lower cane back to floor and raise three cards near shoulder, coat tails settle, relaxed sly smile. No painted card projectiles or swirls.
